stock.description: Xinyi Energy Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise primarily focused on the ownership, operation, and management of solar power facilities. These photovoltaic (PV) farms, situated across the People's Republic of China, collectively boast an installed generation capacity of 2,494 megawatts. The energy produced by these assets is subsequently supplied to state-owned grid companies. Established in 2015, the company maintains its principal base of operations in Wuhu, China, and functions as a subsidiary of Xinyi Solar Holdings Limited.
